answer: Price each identity to a scarce external hardware anchor; standing ripens slowly like a tended garden, each plot earned only when several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign its audited work, inking a permanent pigment of reputation no clone can wash out. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet traces every endorsement to one root, so its plots never bloom across distinct clusters and its clones scatter like startled falcons, each needing its own anchor and slow climb: 100 fakes cost 100 anchors plus 100 climbs versus honest once.
